card.name: Mapale
card.profile: A fast, energetic Afro-Colombian dance of the Caribbean coast (Magdalena River banks, Cartagena, San Basilio de Palenque), named after the Cathorops mapale fish whose out-of-water movements inspired the steps (Wikipedia; Sounds and Colours). Driven by tambor alegre and tambora with handclaps and singing; emphasizes rapid hip and torso isolation and athletic improvisation. Originally a fishermen's night dance, later more sensual in character.
card.insight: Declared Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial de la Nacion via Ley 2520 of 2025, together with bullerengue and son de negro (Infobae; Congreso de Colombia).
